company.name: NEARMOTION
company.shortDescription: SaaS Portal for Indoor Navigation though Interactive Digital Mapping & Augmented Reality
company.description: NEARMOTION is an innovative technology company specializing in indoor navigation solutions through interactive digital maps and augmented reality (AR). Their state-of-the-art platform empowers users to navigate complex indoor environments, like malls, airports, and large corporate campuses, with ease and precision. By harnessing the power of AR, NEARMOTION enhances the user experience, overlaying digital information onto the physical world to guide visitors directly to their destinations. Their services are designed not only for wayfinding but also for engaging customer interactions, offering businesses a unique tool to connect with their audience. As a leader in the indoor navigation space, NEARMOTION is at the forefront of blending the digital with the physical, providing intuitive and seamless experiences for users worldwide.
